proof_applicability: Exact product version, OS, profile, adapter identity, and source hashes are required; a version change requires a fresh proof review.
scope: Fresh native parent exits before the detached external controller starts a distinct child. One native CLI process is active at a time. Active pause/stop and stale-controller recovery cover this bounded fixture only; no host reboot, terminal hangup, native scheduler delivery, global memory, OpenForage worker checkpoint/stop, registration, search, evaluation, or submission is proved. The proof explicitly uses the isolated adapter profile; it does not test each user's plugin/tool config.
